sections.heading: Connecting California Supply with Global Demand
sections.content:
Prime Nuts USA is a California-based sourcing and trading company focused on connecting qualified international buyers with the California almond supply chain.

We simplify procurement by providing buyers with a local sourcing partner who understands supplier communication, product specifications, commercial requirements, logistics, and international trade.

sections.heading: Sourced from California. Supplied to Your Requirements.
sections.content:
California is the center of the global almond industry, supported by an extensive network of experienced growers, handlers, processors, and exporters.

Prime Nuts USA helps wholesale buyers source California almonds according to their specific commercial requirements, including variety, grade, size, crop year, packaging, order volume, destination, and preferred shipping schedule.

sections.heading: A Local Point of Contact for Your Almond Purchases
sections.content:
Working with suppliers from overseas can involve multiple parties, delayed communication, and unclear product availability.

Prime Nuts USA provides international buyers with a California-based sourcing contact. You send us your purchasing requirements, and our team identifies suitable supply options, coordinates commercial details, and follows the order through export preparation and cargo dispatch.

metadata.note: Our objective is simple: to make purchasing California almonds more efficient, transparent, and reliable for international buyers.

sections.heading: International Buyers
sections.content: We welcome inquiries for recurring supply programs as well as spot purchases based on current California market availability.

items.question: California-Based Sourcing
items.answer: Our location in California allows us to communicate efficiently with suppliers, processors, and logistics partners operating within the almond supply chain.

items.question: Multiple Supply Options
items.answer: We are not limited to a single variety or supply source. This allows us to evaluate different options according to each buyer’s specifications, volume, destination, and commercial requirements.

items.question: Buyer-Focused Procurement
items.answer: We begin with your requirements and source accordingly. Our goal is to find supply that fits your market—not to push a predetermined product.

items.question: Export Coordination
items.answer: We assist with the commercial, documentation, and logistics coordination needed to move California almonds to international destinations.

items.question: Long-Term Supply Relationships
items.answer: Our focus extends beyond individual transactions. We aim to build dependable sourcing relationships with qualified buyers who require consistent access to California almond supply.

products.title: Our Products
products.lead: We source California almonds based on customer requirements, applications, and market demand — from natural kernels to processed formats for food manufacturing.
products.metaTitle: Our Products — Prime Nuts USA | California Almonds
products.metaDescription: Natural and processed California almonds — Nonpareil, Independence, Monterey, Carmel, Butte, Padre kernels plus blanched, sliced, slivered, diced almonds and almond flour.

sections.heading: Natural Almond Kernels
sections.content: Whole natural kernels with skin on, sourced from California’s leading varieties for snacking, roasting, retail, and industrial programs.

metadata.imageAlt: Raw natural almond kernels in a white ramekin on a wooden board

items.title: Nonpareil
items.text: The flagship California variety — light color and a smooth, attractive kernel, the benchmark for premium snacking and retail programs.

items.title: Independence
items.text: A widely planted modern variety with an appealing, versatile kernel — a dependable option for snacking and blanching alike.

items.title: Monterey
items.text: A larger, elongated kernel and a dependable workhorse for industrial, ingredient, and manufacturing use.

items.title: Carmel
items.text: A versatile kernel well suited to roasting, blanching, and a broad range of food-manufacturing applications.

items.title: Butte
items.text: A smaller, rounded Mission-type kernel — popular for snack mixes, roasting, and export markets where compact sizes are preferred.

items.title: Padre
items.text: A hardy Mission-type variety with a plump kernel and rich flavor — well suited to roasting, dicing, and processed applications.

sections.heading: Processed Formats for Food Manufacturing
sections.content: Value-added almond formats prepared to commercial specifications for bakery, confectionery, dairy, and ingredient applications. Product selection is based on variety, grade, size, crop year, specifications, packaging, and intended application.

items.title: Blanched
items.text: Whole kernels with skins removed — clean, ivory color for marzipan, confectionery, and premium bakery use.

items.title: Sliced
items.text: Thin, uniform slices — natural or blanched — for bakery toppings, cereals, salads, and garnishes.

items.title: Slivered
items.text: Julienne-cut blanched kernels — a classic format for baking, rice dishes, pilafs, and garnish.

items.title: Diced
items.text: Uniform pieces in a range of cut sizes — ideal for chocolate and candy inclusions, ice cream, and granola.

items.title: Almond Flour & Meal
items.text: Finely ground blanched flour and natural meal — for gluten-free baking, macarons, coatings, and ingredient blends.

metadata.note: Product selection is based on variety, grade, size, crop year, specifications, packaging, and intended application.
